branch.log: I tracked them down. They were armed.

options.label: File a fake claim for more

branch.log: Insurance paid out the inflated claim.
Insurance investigated. Now I'm being prosecuted.

options.label: Move out — never feel safe again

outcome.log: I broke my lease and moved across town.

aftermath.title: Moved
aftermath.text: Lost the deposit. Gained peace of mind.

variants.title: Surprise
variants.body: My family threw me a surprise party. I hate parties.

outcome.log: I smiled through it. They never knew.
I told them I hated surprises. They cried.

aftermath.title: Honest
aftermath.text: They meant well. I ruined it.

outcome.log: I drank too much. Cried during the toast.
I left without saying goodbye.

aftermath.title: Bailed
aftermath.text: They were still cutting cake when I left.

options.label: Use the moment to come out / share a secret

branch.log: They were supportive. Best surprise of the night.

aftermath.title: Accepted
aftermath.text: They wrapped me in a hug.

branch.log: It went badly. Half the family left.

aftermath.title: Rejected
aftermath.text: My uncle hasn't spoken to me since.

variants.title: Store
variants.body: Security stopped me at the door with stolen goods in my bag.

branch.log: They let me off with a warning.

aftermath.title: Spared
aftermath.text: They took the stuff back. No cops.

branch.log: They called the cops anyway.
I outran them and got home.

aftermath.title: Escaped
aftermath.text: Heart still racing. Took the long way.

branch.log: They tackled me. Plus a resisting charge now.

options.label: Pay for it now and apologize

outcome.log: I bought everything and apologized profusely.

options.label: Claim I forgot it was in my bag

branch.log: They believed me. Strange but true.

aftermath.title: Believed
aftermath.text: Either I'm convincing or they're tired.

branch.log: They saw it on camera. Added charges for lying.

variants.title: Friend
variants.body: An old friend just asked to borrow $5,000.

outcome.log: I told them not to worry about paying me back.

aftermath.title: Gift
aftermath.text: They cried. Said they'd never forget.

branch.log: They paid me back on time, with interest.
They never paid. Friendship dead.

outcome.log: I gave them $2,500 and said no more.

branch.log: They needed it for cancer treatment.

aftermath.title: Cancer
aftermath.text: I'd have given more if I'd known.

branch.log: They wanted to invest in a sketchy crypto scheme.

outcome.log: I stopped answering. They got the message.

variants.title: Dare
variants.body: My friends dared me to do something stupid.

branch.log: I ate it. Pocketed the cash.
I got food poisoning. Hospitalized.
I made it to the top. Legend.
I fell. Broke my leg.
I fell. They couldn't save me.

aftermath.title: Fatal
aftermath.text: My last memory was their screams.

branch.log: They thought it was charming.
They screenshotted and shared it everywhere.

outcome.log: I said no. They called me a chicken.
I one-upped them. They backed down.

variants.title: Stolen
variants.body: Someone opened credit cards in my name. My credit is destroyed.

branch.log: They fixed it within months.
They were scammers too. Took my money, did nothing.
After months of phone calls, I won it all back.
I missed deadlines. The debt is mine now.

outcome.log: I filed and wiped the slate. Credit destroyed for 7 years.

branch.log: I found them through their orders. Cops arrested them.

aftermath.title: Caught
aftermath.text: They used my address for shipping. Genius.

branch.log: Dead end. Hours wasted.

variants.title: Caught
variants.body: I told a major lie. They just found proof.

branch.log: They doubted themselves. The lie holds.
They had more proof. Now I'm a serial liar.

outcome.log: I owned it all. Painful but clean.
I pinned it on my coworker.

aftermath.title: Framed
aftermath.text: They got fired. I felt sick.

outcome.log: I left mid-sentence and never came back.

aftermath.title: Fled
aftermath.text: They're still waiting for an answer.

variants.title: Funeral
variants.body: At a relative's funeral, the family started fighting over the will.

outcome.log: I left the room when it started.

branch.log: I got my piece. They never spoke to me again.
They contested everything. I got nothing.
I brokered peace. They split it fairly.

aftermath.title: Mediator
aftermath.text: Family thanked me. Got my share too.

branch.log: Both sides turned on me.

aftermath.title: Failed
aftermath.text: They yelled at me until I left.

branch.log: I pocketed an heirloom. Nobody noticed.
My cousin saw me. They're holding it over my head.

options.label: Give a kind eulogy and leave

outcome.log: I spoke beautifully and slipped out.

aftermath.title: Eulogized
aftermath.text: They'll remember me for the right reasons.

variants.title: Plagiarism
variants.body: My professor says I plagiarized my thesis.

options.label: Defend my work in a hearing

branch.log: I proved my work was original. Cleared.

aftermath.title: Cleared
aftermath.text: Walked through my methodology. They apologized.

branch.log: They found the source. I was expelled.

aftermath.title: Expelled
aftermath.text: They had the original paper. Bad day.

outcome.log: I confessed. Got a failing grade but stayed enrolled.

aftermath.title: Failed
aftermath.text: F on the thesis. Bigger F on my self-esteem.

branch.log: They backed down to avoid scandal.
They doubled down. I was expelled and sued.

outcome.log: I withdrew before they could expel me.

aftermath.title: Withdrew
aftermath.text: Quit before they could write the verdict.

variants.title: Midlife
variants.body: I'm staring at the ceiling at 3am wondering what I'm doing with my life.

branch.log: Best year of my life. Came back changed.

aftermath.title: Reborn
aftermath.text: Six months in Asia and Europe.

branch.log: I burned through savings and came home broke and lonely.

aftermath.title: Drained
aftermath.text: Money gone. Job gone. Same problems.

outcome.log: I bought a midlife-crisis convertible.

branch.log: It was a brief, secret thrill. They never knew.
My partner found out. Divorce.

outcome.log: I started weekly therapy. Slow but real progress.
I doubled down on work and ignored everything.

aftermath.title: Suppressed
aftermath.text: Working 70 hours a week and crying in the car.

variants.title: DNA Test
variants.body: A DNA test just told me I have a sibling I never knew existed.

branch.log: We met. Instant connection. New family.

aftermath.title: Found
aftermath.text: They look so much like me.

branch.log: They're a mess. They moved in and won't leave.

outcome.log: I deleted the email and forgot it.

aftermath.title: Ignored
aftermath.text: They tried to reach out. I never replied.

branch.log: My dad had an affair I never knew about.

aftermath.title: Truth
aftermath.text: Family will never be the same.

branch.log: It was a mix-up at the hospital. Adoption.

aftermath.title: Adopted
aftermath.text: Everything I knew about myself was a lie.

options.label: Try to get their inheritance share

branch.log: DNA confirmed it. I got a cut of their family money.
They lawyered up. I got nothing and made an enemy.

variants.title: Promotion
variants.body: My boss offered me a big promotion, but I'd have to move cities.

outcome.log: I packed up and moved for the new role.

aftermath.title: Moved
aftermath.text: New city. New title. New salary.

branch.log: They agreed to remote. Best of both worlds.

aftermath.title: Remote
aftermath.text: All the money, none of the move.

branch.log: They withdrew the offer.

outcome.log: I turned it down. They were surprised.

branch.log: They actually agreed.
They withdrew the offer entirely.

variants.title: Stalker
variants.body: Someone has been following me. They know where I live.

branch.log: The order worked. They moved on.
They violated it within weeks.

outcome.log: I packed up overnight and disappeared.

branch.log: They were embarrassed and stopped.

aftermath.title: Confronted
aftermath.text: They were just a sad fan.

branch.log: They attacked me when I confronted them.

outcome.log: The PI got me evidence for criminal charges.

aftermath.title: Pursued
aftermath.text: Their face on a police report.

variants.title: Disaster
variants.body: A major storm/earthquake hit my city. My home is damaged.

branch.log: Insurance covered most of it.

aftermath.title: Covered
aftermath.text: Out of pocket $3k. Rebuild starts soon.

branch.log: Claim denied. The damage type wasn't covered.

outcome.log: I rescued neighbors before saving my own stuff.

aftermath.title: Hero
aftermath.text: Local news called me a hero.

branch.log: I made out with thousands in goods.
National guard caught me.

aftermath.title: Arrested
aftermath.text: Looting during emergency is a felony.

outcome.log: I left and started over somewhere else.

aftermath.title: Evacuated
aftermath.text: New start in a new state.

outcome.log: I rebuilt with my own two hands over years.

variants.title: Mistake
variants.body: Police arrested me for a crime I didn't commit. Wrong person.

branch.log: They sorted it out in hours. Released with apology.

aftermath.title: Cleared
aftermath.text: Booked for nothing. Out same night.

branch.log: Despite the truth, I was held for weeks before trial.

aftermath.title: Held
aftermath.text: Three weeks in lockup for nothing.

outcome.log: My lawyer had me out by morning.
I tried to flee. Now I have real charges.

aftermath.title: Resisted
aftermath.text: They added charges they could prove.

branch.log: I won a wrongful arrest settlement.
The case dragged for years and I lost.

variants.title: Contest
variants.body: I entered a regional talent competition on a whim.

branch.log: I won. Trophy, cash, and a sponsorship.
I came in second. Respectable.
I choked on stage and didn't even place.
Somehow I won by sheer charisma.

aftermath.title: Lucky
aftermath.text: Should have practiced. Did fine anyway.

branch.log: Predictably bad performance.
Bribe accepted. I won.
They reported the bribe.
My sabotage worked. They DQ'd. I won.
I got caught and was banned for life.

outcome.log: I dropped out before performing.

variants.title: Mugging
variants.body: Someone just pulled a knife on me in an alley.

outcome.log: They took my wallet and ran.

branch.log: I disarmed them. Held them till cops came.

aftermath.title: Won
aftermath.text: Knife on the floor, them on the floor.

branch.log: They stabbed me before fleeing.
I outran them. Safe.
They caught me. Took everything plus a beating.
They got scared and ran off.
They didn't care. Took everything.

variants.title: Headhunter
variants.body: A competitor reached out with a bigger offer.

outcome.log: I quit and started fresh.

options.label: Use it to get a raise here

branch.log: My boss matched the offer.
My boss took it as disloyalty and fired me.

outcome.log: I turned it down. They respected my loyalty.

options.label: Take it AND keep the old job (moonlighting)

branch.log: I pulled it off for a year. Doubled my income.

aftermath.title: Hustled
aftermath.text: Two jobs, zero sleep, more money.

branch.log: Both employers found out. Fired from both.

variants.title: Doorstep
variants.body: There's a baby on my doorstep with a note.

outcome.log: I called child services and started the adoption process.
I took the baby to the police. They'd find a family.

aftermath.title: Handed Over
aftermath.text: The right thing. Still feels weird.

branch.log: I found them and made them take the baby back.
I never found them. Wasted weeks.
I found a family that paid handsomely.
FBI sting. I'm going away forever.

variants.title: Neighbor
variants.body: My new neighbor plays loud music every single night.

branch.log: They apologized and turned it down.
They got hostile.

aftermath.title: Hostile
aftermath.text: They turned it up to spite me.

branch.log: After enough noise complaints, they were evicted.
They started retaliating with vandalism.

outcome.log: I bought a louder system. We're at war now.
I sold and moved. New neighborhood.

branch.log: They never figured out who did it. They moved.
They caught me on their dashcam.

variants.title: Witness
variants.body: I just saw a crime happen. They didn't see me.

branch.log: My testimony put them away. Civic duty done.
Their friends came looking for me.

outcome.log: I pretended I didn't see it.

branch.log: They paid me to stay quiet. Monthly.
They killed me to silence me.

outcome.log: I called Crime Stoppers from a payphone.

aftermath.title: Anonymous
aftermath.text: They got the bad guy. I stayed out of it.

variants.title: Idea
variants.body: I just thought of an invention that could change everything.

branch.log: My prototype worked. I got a patent.
It didn't work. Money down the drain.
They funded me. Six figures to build.
They all passed. Demoralizing.

options.label: Sell the idea to a company

branch.log: They bought it outright.
They stole the idea after I pitched.

outcome.log: I shelved the idea. Maybe later.

variants.title: Pet
variants.body: My pet just collapsed. They need emergency surgery.

branch.log: They pulled through. Worth every dollar.

aftermath.title: Saved
aftermath.text: They're sleeping next to me right now.

branch.log: They died on the table.

outcome.log: I held them as they slipped away.
They died at home. I couldn't afford it.

aftermath.title: Couldn't
aftermath.text: I held them. That's all I could give.

branch.log: They recovered slowly at home.
They died because I waited.

aftermath.title: Failed
aftermath.text: Should have gone to the vet.

variants.title: DUI
variants.body: Flashing lights behind me. I had way too many drinks.

outcome.log: I blew over. DUI charges.
Auto-suspension and a fight in court ahead.

branch.log: Somehow I escaped them on side streets.
I crashed into another car. Multiple charges.

aftermath.title: Crashed
aftermath.text: Other driver in ICU. Five years.

branch.log: They took the money and waved me on.
They reported the bribe attempt. Bigger charges now.

variants.title: School
variants.body: I lost my lunch money on the way to school today.

outcome.log: A friend split her sandwich with me.

aftermath.title: Lunch Saved
aftermath.text: She gave me half her PB&J. I'll pay it back tomorrow.

outcome.log: The lunch lady gave me a free meal but made me feel small.
I skipped lunch and stared at my desk.
I swiped a cookie when no one was looking.

aftermath.title: Sticky Fingers
aftermath.text: Nobody saw, but I feel sick.

variants.title: Playground
variants.body: There's a new kid in class. They look lonely.

outcome.log: I invited the new kid to play tag. We're friends now.

aftermath.title: New Friend
aftermath.text: We chased each other till the bell rang.

outcome.log: I ignored the new kid. They sat alone.
I made fun of the new kid. They cried.

aftermath.title: Mean Streak
aftermath.text: They cried. I told myself it was just a joke.

variants.title: Show and Tell
variants.body: It's show-and-tell day. What do I bring?

outcome.log: The class was bored. I clutched my rocks.
The class liked the beach pictures.
The teacher confiscated it and called my parents.
The class loved it. The teacher was impressed.

variants.title: Class Pet
variants.body: Mrs. Henderson asked who wants to take the class hamster home this weekend.

outcome.log: I took home Mr. Whiskers. He was great.

aftermath.title: Best Weekend
aftermath.text: I fed him pellets and watched him run on his wheel.

options.label: Volunteer then forget to feed him

outcome.log: Mr. Whiskers escaped. I cried.
A quieter kid got picked instead.

variants.title: Birthday Party
variants.body: I got invited to a classmate's birthday party at a trampoline park.

outcome.log: I bounced for three hours straight and ate cake.
I sprained my ankle on the trampolines.
I stayed home. I heard it was fun.

variants.title: Teacher Trouble
variants.body: Mr. Greene yelled at me in front of the whole class for talking.

outcome.log: My face burned. Other kids stared.
I told him he was unfair. Detention.
I said sorry. He softened.
My parents called the principal.

variants.title: Lost
variants.body: I lost my parents in a big department store. The aisles all look the same.

outcome.log: The guard called my parents over the speaker.
A nice lady found me and got help.
My parents found me before anything bad happened.

variants.title: Sleepover
variants.body: I'm invited to my first-ever sleepover.

outcome.log: We stayed up till midnight watching movies.
I called my mom at 11pm. She came to get me.
I told my friend I couldn't make it.

variants.title: Picked Last
variants.body: I got picked last for kickball. Again.

outcome.log: I pretended I didn't care, but I did.
I'm getting better. Slowly.
I sat out the next game. Felt empty.

variants.title: Caught
variants.body: Mom caught me lying about brushing my teeth.

outcome.log: She was disappointed but proud I told the truth.
She caught me again and I was grounded.
The tears worked. Sort of.

variants.title: Bully
variants.body: There's an older kid in the neighborhood who keeps shoving me.

outcome.log: I yelled back and they backed off.
I yelled back and got punched.
My dad talked to their parents. The shoving stopped.
I take the long way home now.

options.label: Get a bigger friend to help

outcome.log: My older cousin came over. The bully ran.

variants.title: Summer Camp
variants.body: My parents signed me up for two weeks of summer camp.

outcome.log: I made best friends and learned to canoe.
I survived. Barely.
My parents made me anyway.

variants.title: Pet
variants.body: My goldfish died this morning.

outcome.log: We buried him in the backyard with full ceremony.
Quick goodbye. Felt wrong.
My parents agreed but said no fish.

variants.title: Tooth
variants.body: My first loose tooth finally came out.

outcome.log: I got two dollars from the Tooth Fairy.
I started a tooth collection.
The Tooth Fairy didn't come. I cried.

variants.title: Accident
variants.body: I broke a neighbor's window with my baseball.

outcome.log: I avoided the street for weeks. The guilt was worse.
They were kind. My parents paid for repairs.
The other kid got in trouble. I felt awful.

variants.title: Test
variants.body: I got a D on my math test.

outcome.log: They found it weeks later. Even worse.
They helped me study. Next test was a B.
The teacher noticed. Big trouble.

variants.title: Test
variants.body: I aced the spelling test.

outcome.log: My friends thought I was a show-off.
They put it on the fridge.
I tutored a friend and we both got A's next time.

variants.title: Gifted
variants.body: I tested into the gifted-and-talented program.

outcome.log: The work is harder but more interesting.
I stayed with my regular class.
I didn't want to leave my friends.

variants.title: Project
variants.body: My diorama is due tomorrow. I haven't started.

outcome.log: My mom helped. The diorama looked great.
The teacher noticed. C-minus.
Bought a day. The next day was worse.

variants.title: Field Trip
variants.body: We're going to the zoo on a field trip.

outcome.log: I learned about red pandas.
The chaperone freaked out. I got grounded.
I had to stay back at school. Boring day.

variants.title: Chores
variants.body: Mom started a chore chart with allowance attached.

outcome.log: I earned $10 a week.
My allowance was cut in half.

options.label: Bribe my sibling to do them

outcome.log: My sibling told. Mom was not amused.

variants.title: Grandparents
variants.body: Grandma and Grandpa are visiting for the weekend.

outcome.log: Grandma taught me to bake. Grandpa told stories.
I missed out and Grandma seemed hurt.
Grandpa slipped me $20 and a wink.

variants.title: Sibling
variants.body: My sibling broke my favorite toy.

outcome.log: I broke their toy too. Mom punished us both.
They got in trouble. We didn't talk for a week.
They cried and apologized. We're closer now.

variants.title: Parents
variants.body: I heard my parents arguing loudly last night.

outcome.log: She said it's grown-up stuff. I worried anyway.
The worry sat in my chest for weeks.
They hugged me. The arguments quieted down.

variants.title: New Sibling
variants.body: Mom is having another baby.

outcome.log: I held my new sibling first.
I felt invisible for months.
I learned to change diapers at 8.

variants.title: Moving
variants.body: My parents told us we're moving across the state.

outcome.log: New school, new friends, new chapter.

options.label: Refuse to talk to my old friends

outcome.log: I cut everyone off and regretted it.
We laughed and cried. I keep in touch.

variants.title: Missing Pet
variants.body: Our dog ran off and we can't find him.

outcome.log: A neighbor called. Found him two streets over.
Mom and Dad searched. Found him in a day.
I got lost too. Both rescued at sunset.

variants.title: Imaginary Friend
variants.body: I have an imaginary friend named Pip. He follows me everywhere.

outcome.log: Other kids thought I was weird.
Pip was my only confidant.

options.label: Have Pip blame everything on himself

outcome.log: My parents got concerned.

variants.title: Nightmare
variants.body: I had a horrible nightmare and woke up screaming.

outcome.log: They held me until morning.
I read till sunrise.
The monster was right above me. I never told anyone.

variants.title: Treehouse
variants.body: The neighborhood kids built a treehouse and made a secret club.

outcome.log: I was the lookout. We saved snacks for emergencies.
I watched from the ground.
I built mine in our yard. Bigger.

variants.title: Lemonade Stand
variants.body: I want to set up a lemonade stand to earn money.

outcome.log: I made $24 in an afternoon.
No customers. Two glasses sold.
A customer complained. My parents were horrified.

variants.title: Movies
variants.body: First time at the movie theater, by myself with a friend.

outcome.log: I felt sick by the credits.

options.label: Try to sneak into another movie

outcome.log: The usher caught us. Mom was called.

options.label: Enjoy the movie like a normal kid

outcome.log: Best afternoon all summer.

variants.title: Coat Lost
variants.body: I lost my brand-new winter coat at school. It's freezing out.

outcome.log: I found my coat in the lost-and-found bin.
I walked home in just my sweatshirt. I got sick.

options.label: Tell mom and brace for it

outcome.log: Mom was mad. I had to do extra chores to pay for a new one.
I 'borrowed' a coat without asking. The teacher called mom.

variants.title: Glue Eater
variants.body: My teacher caught me eating a glue stick. The whole class is staring.

outcome.log: I spit it out and said sorry. The teacher laughed it off.
I lied and said I thought it was a snack. Nobody believed me.
I ate the whole glue stick. I got sent to the nurse and threw up.

variants.title: Dentist
variants.body: First trip to the dentist. The chair leans back. The drill noise is everywhere.

outcome.log: I sat still. The dentist gave me a toy.
I cried through the whole checkup. Mom apologized to everyone.
I bit the dentist. We have a new dentist now.

variants.title: Choir Audition
variants.body: I'm auditioning for the school choir. They want me to sing 'Twinkle Twinkle'.

outcome.log: I sang loud and proud. I made the choir.
I mumbled and got cut. There's always next year.
I ran out of the audition crying. Mom was disappointed.

variants.title: Bike Crash
variants.body: I crashed my bike going down the hill. My knee is bleeding. The bike is dented.

options.label: Get back on and ride home

outcome.log: I got back on and rode home. Mom bandaged my knee.
A neighbor saw me and drove me home. The bike's a goner.
I hid the cut. It got infected later.

variants.title: Good Deed
variants.body: An old lady on my street dropped her groceries. Cans rolled into the road.

outcome.log: I helped Mrs. Patel with her groceries. She gave me a cookie.
I walked past her. I felt bad about it for days.
I took a can of tuna and bolted. Mom found it later. Yelling ensued.

variants.title: Crush
variants.body: I have my first crush. They sit two desks away. I cannot focus on long division.

outcome.log: I passed a note. They smiled. My heart exploded.
The best friend told everyone. I died a thousand deaths.
I said nothing. They moved away in 5th grade.

variants.title: School Play
variants.body: I was cast in the school play. I have three lines and a costume that itches.

outcome.log: I nailed all three lines. The audience clapped.
I froze on stage. The teacher whispered the lines from the wings.
I faked a stomach ache. Someone else took my role. I regretted it.

variants.title: Candy Thief
variants.body: I tried to take a candy bar from the store without paying. The cashier saw me.

outcome.log: I put it back and apologized. The cashier let me off.
I ran. The cashier called mom. I was grounded for a month.

options.label: Cry until they let me go

outcome.log: I cried so hard they let me leave. Mom heard about it anyway.

variants.title: Picture Day
variants.body: It's school picture day. Mom combed my hair flat. My shirt is starchy.

outcome.log: My school picture turned out great. Grandma got a copy.
I made a weird face on purpose. Mom was furious.
I blinked. The picture is awful. Grandma framed it anyway.

variants.title: Halloween
variants.body: It's pumpkin carving day. I have a knife my parents say is safe.

outcome.log: I carved a jack-o-lantern. We put it on the porch.
I tried to carve a cat. It looked like a potato. I was proud anyway.
The knife slipped. Three stitches.

variants.title: Lost Swim Suit
variants.body: I lost my swim suit at the pool. Everyone is leaving the locker room.

options.label: Wrap in a towel and wait for mom

outcome.log: I wrapped up in a towel until mom came. Embarrassing but okay.
I wore a too-big stranger's swimsuit home. Mom threw it out.
I walked out in soggy underwear. Whole town heard about it.

variants.title: First Skateboard
variants.body: Got my first skateboard. The driveway is calling.

outcome.log: I practiced for hours and got pretty good.

options.label: Try the hill on day one

outcome.log: I tried the steep hill. I crashed and broke my wrist.

options.label: Let a friend try it first

outcome.log: My friend cracked it on the first ride. We're not friends anymore.

variants.title: Stranger at the Park
variants.body: A stranger at the park asked me where my mom is.

outcome.log: I ran to the lifeguard. The stranger left. Mom said I did the right thing.
I ignored them. They wandered off.
I told them. Mom panicked when she heard. Long talk about strangers.

variants.title: Christmas Morning
variants.body: Christmas morning. Did Santa bring what I asked for?

outcome.log: Santa came through. Best Christmas ever.

options.label: I got socks and a sweater

outcome.log: Santa gave me socks. I pretended to love them.
Santa skipped our house this year. I cried.

variants.title: First Phone

variants.title: First Day of School
variants.body: Today is my first day of kindergarten. Mom dropped me off at a big building full of strangers.

outcome.log: I marched into kindergarten like I owned it.
I cried so hard mom had to peel me off.
I hid until a teacher found me.

variants.title: Lost in the Hallway
variants.body: I got separated from my class and don't know where my room is.

outcome.log: A teacher walked me back to class.
I just sat in the hallway crying until they found me.
I scared a bunch of fifth-graders by appearing in their room.

variants.title: Show-and-Tell
variants.body: It's show-and-tell day. I have to bring something special and talk about it in front of everyone.

outcome.log: I brought my stuffed bear and told everyone its name.

options.label: Bring something gross from the yard

outcome.log: I brought a dead beetle. The teacher was not impressed.
I forgot. I had to make something up on the spot.

options.label: Bring a story I wrote myself

outcome.log: I read my own story out loud. The teacher said I was talented.

variants.title: Nap Time
variants.body: It's quiet time and the teacher wants everyone to nap. I'm not tired.

outcome.log: I faked sleep for a solid hour.

options.label: Whisper to the kid next to me

outcome.log: The teacher caught me whispering and moved my mat.
I conked out and slept through pickup.

variants.title: The Neighbor's Dog
variants.body: The neighbor's big dog is loose in the yard. It's barking and running at me.

outcome.log: The dog sniffed me, wagged its tail, and trotted off.
I ran. The dog chased me and nipped my heel.
I missed. The dog's owner saw and yelled at my parents.

variants.title: Imaginary Friend
variants.body: I have an imaginary friend named Sprinkles. The grown-ups keep asking about her.

outcome.log: I described Sprinkles in great detail. Mom seemed worried.

options.label: Pretend she's not real to make them stop

outcome.log: I lied and said she went away.
I dug in. Mom set a place for her at dinner.

variants.title: First Big Lie
variants.body: I broke a vase. Mom is asking what happened.

outcome.log: I confessed. Mom was disappointed but proud I was honest.
I said the cat did it. Mom seemed to believe me.

options.label: Cry hysterically until she stops asking

outcome.log: I melted down until she gave up asking.

variants.title: Birthday Party Invite
variants.body: A kid in my class is having a birthday party. Everyone's invited except me.

outcome.log: Mom called the other mom. Now I'm invited. Awkward.

options.label: Pretend I didn't want to go anyway

outcome.log: I told everyone I had better plans.
I begged for a competing party. Mom said no.

options.label: Befriend another kid who wasn't invited

outcome.log: Me and another kid who got left out became best friends.

variants.title: Lost a Tooth
variants.body: My first tooth fell out! It's all bloody and weird and exciting.

outcome.log: The Tooth Fairy left me $5. Score.

options.label: Show it to everyone in class

outcome.log: I showed off my tooth. Some kids were grossed out.
I lost the tooth itself. No fairy money.

variants.title: Picked Last in Gym
variants.body: We're picking kickball teams in gym class. I'm always last. Today is no different.

options.label: Try harder than ever to prove them wrong

outcome.log: I scored the winning run. Captains noticed.

options.label: Fake an injury to sit out

outcome.log: I faked a stomachache. The nurse let me skip.
I stared at clouds the whole game.

variants.title: Reading Aloud
variants.body: The teacher wants me to read my page out loud to the whole class.

outcome.log: I nailed it. The teacher praised my reading voice.
I mumbled. The teacher made me redo it.
I faked illness. Got sent to the nurse.

variants.title: The Recess Bully
variants.body: A bigger kid is pushing me on the playground and laughing.

outcome.log: I shoved them down. We both got sent to the office.
The teacher made the kid apologize. Nothing changed at lunch.
I let them push me. I felt awful all day.

options.label: Make a joke out of it

outcome.log: I started laughing too. It threw them off.

variants.title: Lost My Lunch Money
variants.body: I went to buy lunch and my lunch money is gone. Did it fall out of my pocket?

outcome.log: My friend gave me half their sandwich.
I stole a kid's juice box. He cried.

options.label: Skip lunch and tough it out

outcome.log: I was starving by 2pm.
The lunch lady gave me a free meal. So nice.

variants.title: Field Trip
variants.body: We're going on a field trip to the zoo. Everyone's hyped.

outcome.log: We laughed at the monkeys for an hour.

options.label: Run off to see the snakes alone

outcome.log: I got lost in the reptile house. They almost left without me.

options.label: Spend all my money in the gift shop

outcome.log: I came home with a stuffed lion and no money.

variants.title: Science Fair Project
variants.body: There's a school science fair. My project is due in three weeks.

options.label: Build something cool with my parents

outcome.log: Dad helped me build a working volcano. I got 2nd place.

options.label: Throw something together the night before

outcome.log: I drew a poster about clouds. Got participation ribbon.

options.label: Cheat and use a sibling's old project

outcome.log: The teacher recognized it and called my parents.
I told the teacher I forgot. She was disappointed.

variants.title: Caught Doing Something Gross
variants.body: Someone caught me picking my nose in class and now everyone's laughing.

outcome.log: I owned it. Kids actually liked me more.
I bolted. The teacher had to chase me down.
I insisted it never happened. Nobody believed me.

variants.title: First Sleepover
variants.body: I got invited to my first sleepover. Mom's letting me go.

options.label: Have the best night of my life

outcome.log: We stayed up late watching movies. Best night ever.

options.label: Get scared and call mom at midnight

outcome.log: I got homesick and mom picked me up at midnight.

options.label: Eat way too much junk food

outcome.log: I threw up at 2am. The host's parents were not amused.

variants.title: Bringing the Class Pet Home
variants.body: It's my turn to take the class hamster home for the weekend.

outcome.log: The teacher praised my pet-care report on Monday.

options.label: Forget to feed it for a day

outcome.log: The hamster was okay but skinny when I returned it.

options.label: Lose the hamster in the house

outcome.log: I lost it. We never found it. The class was devastated.

variants.title: First Crush
variants.body: There's a kid in my class who makes my stomach feel weird when they look at me.

outcome.log: I slipped a note in their desk. They smiled at me.

options.label: Tell my best friend about it

outcome.log: My best friend kept the secret. We've been closer ever since.
I avoided them all week. I felt miserable.
The whole class found out. The crush stopped talking to me.

variants.title: Spelling Bee
variants.body: I made it to the school spelling bee. The word is 'beautiful'.

outcome.log: I spelled it right. Made it to the next round.

options.label: Spell it wrong on purpose to escape the stage

outcome.log: I bailed. I always wondered if I could've won.
I forgot how to spell. Brutal.

variants.title: Parents Are Fighting
variants.body: Mom and Dad have been yelling at each other behind closed doors. Something is very wrong.

outcome.log: They said they were 'working things out.' I knew they were lying.
I distracted myself with cartoons and tried not to listen.
I drew them a picture. They both hugged me but it didn't fix anything.

variants.title: Lemonade Stand
variants.body: Me and my friends want to set up a lemonade stand this summer.

options.label: Run it like a real business

outcome.log: We made $40 in a weekend. I was hooked on making money.
We made no money but had a great time.
The neighborhood thought I was so sweet. I made zero dollars.

variants.title: Bike Crash
variants.body: I was riding my bike too fast down a hill and crashed hard.

options.label: Walk it off and ride home

outcome.log: I'm tougher than I look. Got home with just scrapes.

options.label: Sit and cry until someone finds me

outcome.log: A neighbor found me sobbing. They drove me home.

options.label: Blame the bike and refuse to ride again

outcome.log: My bike sat in the garage for two years.

variants.title: First Big Test
variants.body: We got our first real graded test back. Mine is at the bottom of the pile.

outcome.log: I aced it. Mom put it on the fridge.
I bombed it. My parents had The Talk with me.

options.label: Look at it after school in private

outcome.log: I peeked at home — it was bad. I hid it.
I asked for advice and went with it.

variants.title: School Play Audition
variants.body: There are auditions for the school play next week.

outcome.log: I got the lead role! I felt unstoppable on opening night.
I got a tiny part. It was still fun.
I painted sets and learned about lights. I loved it.
I watched everyone else have fun. I regretted it.

variants.title: Big Fight With Sibling
variants.body: Me and my sibling are in a huge fight over something stupid.

outcome.log: I caved and apologized. They hugged me.
We didn't speak for a month. I won, I guess.

options.label: Tell parents and get them in trouble

outcome.log: My sibling got grounded. They never forgave me.

options.label: Trash their room when they're out

outcome.log: They cried. I felt awful for a week.

variants.title: A Grandparent Died
variants.body: I just found out one of my grandparents passed away. Mom is crying.

outcome.log: We grieved together. It actually helped.

options.label: Try to be the strong one

outcome.log: I hid my own grief to help mom. It cost me.

options.label: Ask too many questions about death

outcome.log: The questions made my parents uncomfortable but I needed to know.

variants.title: Got My First Phone
variants.body: My parents finally gave me a phone. There are RULES.

outcome.log: I followed every rule. They started trusting me more.

options.label: Sneak it under the covers at night

outcome.log: I stayed up too late watching videos.

options.label: Download apps mom said not to

outcome.log: Mom found a game I wasn't supposed to have. Phone got taken away for a month.

variants.title: Mean Group of Kids
variants.body: There's a group at school that decides who's cool. They're asking if I want to join.

options.label: Join them — even if it means being mean to others

outcome.log: I joined. I felt cool but I was a jerk.

options.label: Refuse and stick with my real friends

outcome.log: I said no. My real friends had my back.

options.label: Try to convince them to be nicer

outcome.log: They laughed at me. I lost both groups.

variants.title: Pet Died
variants.body: My pet died this morning. I knew it would happen eventually but I'm devastated.

outcome.log: We buried her under the oak tree. I still visit sometimes.

options.label: Beg for a new pet immediately

outcome.log: Mom said no. I sulked for a week.
I bottled it up. It came out years later in weird ways.

variants.title: Class Clown Moment
variants.body: I made the whole class laugh today. The teacher is staring at me with murder eyes.

outcome.log: I got sent to the principal. Worth it.
I shut down for the rest of the day. Embarrassing.

options.label: Use my charm to talk my way out of trouble

outcome.log: I sweet-talked the teacher and got off with a warning.

variants.title: Caught Cheating
variants.body: I copied a kid's answers and the teacher saw me. She's writing a note home.

options.label: Beg her not to tell my parents

outcome.log: She told them anyway. I was grounded for two weeks.
I owned it. The teacher actually respected that.
The teacher saw through it. Now I have a reputation.

variants.title: Puberty Hits
variants.body: Something is happening to my body. I don't fully understand and I'm freaking out.

options.label: Talk to a parent about it

outcome.log: The talk was awkward but I learned a lot.
I read too much and panicked. I learned wrong things.
I lived in denial. It got worse before I could deal with it.

variants.title: Growth Spurt
variants.body: I grew four inches in two months. None of my clothes fit and I'm clumsy.

outcome.log: I felt awkward but kind of cool too.
I slouched so much my back hurt for years.

options.label: Try out for sports because of new height

outcome.log: The basketball coach noticed me. Tryouts went well.

variants.title: Best Friend
variants.body: I made my first real best friend. We hang out every day after school.

options.label: Try to act cool about it

outcome.log: I played it cool. They thought I didn't care and drifted away.
I let things play out on their own.

variants.title: Got Braces
variants.body: I got braces today. My mouth is killing me and I look like a robot.

outcome.log: I owned it. Kids actually thought it was cute.

options.label: Hide my smile for two years

outcome.log: I barely smiled until they came off. I missed a lot of photos.

options.label: Use them as a comedy bit

outcome.log: I made jokes about my braces. People liked the confidence.

variants.title: Phone Drama
variants.body: Someone screenshotted my private text and it's going around school.

options.label: Confront the person who leaked it

outcome.log: We had it out in the hallway. I felt better but got suspended.
I went silent for a week. The story died eventually.

options.label: Quit social media for a year

outcome.log: I went dark. Came back stronger.

variants.title: First Real Party
variants.body: I got invited to a house party. There will be older kids. And probably alcohol.

outcome.log: I had fun, kept my head, and people respected me for it.
I threw up in someone's bushes. Got grounded for a month.
I went home and watched movies. Felt left out for weeks.
A senior offered me weed. I tried it.

variants.title: First Kiss
variants.body: Someone I like just leaned in. This is happening.

outcome.log: It was awkward and perfect.
I bolted. They never spoke to me again.
I laughed in their face. Worst response possible.

variants.title: Caught With Porn
variants.body: My parents found something on my browser history. We're having The Conversation.

options.label: Own it and have a real talk

outcome.log: The talk was deeply awkward but actually helpful.
They didn't buy it. Phone privileges revoked for a month.
I made it about being disrespected. They didn't bring it up again.

variants.title: Driver's Permit
variants.body: I'm old enough for my learner's permit. Time to take the test.

options.label: Study hard and pass first try

outcome.log: I aced it. Dad started teaching me to drive that weekend.
I failed. Had to wait two weeks and re-study.
I didn't bother. I'd get my license late.

variants.title: Sports Tryouts
variants.body: Varsity tryouts are this week. I've been training all summer.

outcome.log: I made varsity. The coach pulled me aside and said I had real potential.
I made JV. Disappointed but I'll work for it.
I gave up before trying. I always wondered what could've been.
I asked for advice and went with it.

variants.title: First Real Relationship
variants.body: Someone I really like asked me out. We're officially dating.

outcome.log: We dated for two years. They taught me a lot.
We were saying 'I love you' in three days. It crashed and burned in a month.
They found out. The whole school knew. I was the villain.

variants.title: Driver's License Test
variants.body: License test today. My parents are nervous. So am I.

outcome.log: I passed. I drove home solo. Best feeling ever.
I rolled a stop sign. Auto-fail.

options.label: Get nervous and stall the car

outcome.log: I stalled three times. Failed. Had to redo it.

variants.title: First Job
variants.body: I applied for a part-time job. They want to hire me.

outcome.log: I worked there for two years. Saved a chunk of money.
I got fired after three months.
I told them I needed to focus on school. I regretted having no money.

variants.title: SAT Scores
variants.body: Test scores are back. I open the email with shaking hands.

outcome.log: Top 5%. My parents lost their minds.
Above average. Good enough for state schools.
Below average. My college options just got narrower.

options.label: Take it again to do better

outcome.log: I studied for three more months. My score went up significantly.
I stepped back from the whole situation.

variants.title: Prom
variants.body: Prom is in two months. Everyone's pairing up.

options.label: Ask my crush in a big public way

outcome.log: They said yes! It went viral on TikTok.
They said no. In front of the whole cafeteria.
They said yes. We had a perfect night.
We had way more fun than the couples did.
I stayed home and watched movies. I regret it sometimes.

variants.title: College Applications
variants.body: It's college application crunch time.

options.label: Apply to a stretch of dream schools

outcome.log: I got into my top choice! I cried.
I got rejected from every reach school. State school it is.
I got into all my safety schools. No surprises.
I traveled for a year. Best decision of my life so far.
I started looking for a real job. My parents weren't thrilled.

variants.title: High School Graduation
variants.body: Graduation day. I'm about to walk across that stage.

outcome.log: I hugged my friends, took photos with my parents. It was perfect.

options.label: Skip the ceremony and party instead

outcome.log: I missed the ceremony and partied all night. My parents were hurt.
I sobbed through the speeches. I was a wreck. A happy wreck.

variants.title: Grades Are Dropping
variants.body: My grades have been slipping. My parents got the email.

outcome.log: I pulled my grades up. My parents were proud.
The tutor saved me. Grades back up.
I forged my report card. Got caught at parent-teacher night.
I stopped trying. My future got narrower fast.

variants.title: Acne
variants.body: My skin is exploding. Everyone can see it.

outcome.log: Three months of treatment cleared it up.
I scarred my own face. The marks lasted years.
I acted confident anyway. People stopped noticing.

variants.title: Drugs at School
variants.body: Someone is selling pills out of their locker. They're asking if I want one.

outcome.log: I walked away. I felt good about myself.
I took the pill. I had a bad reaction and woke up in the nurse's office.
They got expelled. Their friends made my life hell.

variants.title: Anxiety Attack
variants.body: I had a panic attack in the school bathroom. I could barely breathe.

options.label: Tell my parents and get help

outcome.log: My parents got me into therapy. It changed my life.
I shoved it down. It came back stronger later.
It worked short term. Long term, I had a new problem.

variants.title: Grandparent Dies
variants.body: My grandparent passed away. I'm old enough to feel it differently this time.

outcome.log: We grieved together. It brought us closer.
I gave the eulogy. People said it was beautiful.
I wrote poems for months. Some of them were good.

variants.title: First Word
variants.body: I babbled my very first real word. My parents are losing their minds with joy. What did I say?

outcome.log: My first word was 'mama'. Mom cried happy tears.
My first word was 'dada'. Dad framed the moment.
My first word was 'no'. Already opinionated.
